title: Provable Limits and Certified Deferral for Verbalized Uncertainty in Small Language Models
summary: Provable Limits and Certified Deferral for Verbalized Uncertainty in Small Language Models｜Small open-weight language models increasingly run in private, offline, and cost-sensitiv

extra.description: Small open-weight language models increasingly run in private, offline, and cost-sensitive settings, where the key deployment question is not only what a model answers but when it should defer to a human. We study whether verbalized confidence can support risk-controlled deferral, evaluating eleven instruction-tuned models from three families, 0.5B to 14B parameters, on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA with 25,168 local predictions.
